derivation: The checkpoint is D2-114's result with the evidence digest of its one retained authority-clock sample changed and the last transition not recommitted, so the last receipt's state_after_core_digest no longer hashes the supplied core. No other record in the state binds that evidence digest: the clock event preimage is host-retained and the state carries only its event digest, and the deployment authorization clock is a separate record. A fresh available CLOCK sample asks the consumer to restart from the checkpoint. LIFE-019 has the consumer hash the resulting core as state_after_core_digest before appending the receipt, and refuse any changed digest, missing record or broken binding as STATE_INVALID before applying the next event. The refusal returns the exact supplied state.
